status: Source-grounded private planning only; no production implementation or parity claim.
authority_note: Browser ToolboxService binds makeUniversalTools to DiffHistoryService and forwards undoToolCalls. The separate thin-host createUniversalToolbox undo stub is not the browser contract.

tools.name: copy
semantics: move is a flag on copy, not a separate model tool
Source requires read for copy or delete for move; destination requires create
Missing source errors; file into directory uses source basename; parent directories are created
Directory copy merges children into the specified destination directory, overwrites colliding files and preserves unrelated destination entries; directory into an existing file errors
File move tries rename then copy+unlink fallback; directory move copies recursively then removes source
Destination changes are tracked for copy and move; source deletions are additionally tracked only for move
Directory operations use one batch to retain all destination/source records; _diff is null. Single-file result has message and destination text _diff when tracked

tools.name: delete
semantics: Requires delete permission; missing target errors
File removes one path and records before to missing
Directory captures each descendant file, removes tree, then registers all child deletions in a batch; result _diff is null
The current upstream journal tracks file states, not empty directory topology; empty directory restoration is not established by this implementation

tools.name: write
semantics: Requires write permission, creates parents and replaces contents
Runs stripCodeFence before writing; leading and trailing fences are removed using the exact pinned helper
Message distinguishes created/updated; more than 4000 JS characters adds an incremental-edit warning
Captures before/after and registers attributed history; text result may carry _diff
tools.native_now: Atomic UTF-8 write, creates parents, 4 MiB bound; does not strip fences or return upstream structured result; fileChanged lacks existence/provenance and is not a persistent journal

tools.name: multiEdit

input.edits: array, minimum 1; old_string/new_string required strings, replace_all optional bool

semantics: Existing file required; sequential edits see previous results
Unmatched edits are skipped, not errors; replace_all counts all non-overlapping occurrences, otherwise replaces first occurrence
Writes only when editsApplied is positive; returns message plus result.editsApplied, including successful zero-edits result
Schema accepts empty old_string, but pinned split/index behavior is inconsistent for zero/one/multiple UTF-16 code units; treat as an explicit compatibility edge, not an ordinary replacement contract
tools.native_now: Sequential first/all replacements exist, but unmatched edit aborts the whole operation; empty pattern rejected; strict UTF-8/BOM/newline preservation and 4 MiB byte cap; no structured editsApplied/history

tools.name: mkdir
semantics: Requires create permission; recursively creates parents; existing directory succeeds with already-exists message; existing file errors
No diff-history capture in the pinned implementation
tools.native_now: Implemented with different response text; raw sandbox mkdir has separate Node-style semantics

tools.name: undoToolCalls
tools.exposure: Host/browser API; not a model tool
semantics: Agent-filter tool-call reasons, group affected paths, choose state immediately before earliest selected operation for each file
Append copied operations from initial baseline through target; restore missing/text/external bytes and recreate parents
Undo to an initial baseline adds user-save closure; refresh hydrated agent state
Archive finalizes pending baselines but history remains undoable
Legacy spec describes redo/hunk acceptance; current product note removes per-hunk accept/reject UI and current service exposes no public redo method
tools.native_now: Only editor-local Qt undo/redo and Git diffs exist; no agent tool-call history/undo

mounts.rules: Input is mount-prefixed, backslashes normalize; permissions read/write/create/delete. apps/plans/logs and workspace mounts are writable; att/memory/shells/plugins plus browser global skill mounts are read-only. Static mounts take precedence. Source lexical checks are not a substitute for native final-handle validation.
mounts.native_scope: ws1/w1/workspace and fixed per-agent apps are available; sandbox att is read-only. Other mounts and stable simultaneous workspaces remain explicit gaps. Native unprefixed workspace compatibility and apps without workspace already exist and must not regress.

history.model: Content-addressed snapshots + append-only operations with path, baseline/edit, nullable snapshot_oid, reason and contributor. Missing is null, distinct from empty bytes. Text <= 2 MiB is inline/delta-capable; binary or larger captures use external blob storage.
history.behavior: registerSingleEdit and batch suppress watcher feedback for 500 ms and emit text-written/closed hooks. Directory batches bypass the 50 single-edit fanout limit; batch cap 10000 can still drop tracking after mutation. Gitignored/denylisted files are skipped. Internal apps/plans/logs records are hidden from agent-visible diff summaries.
history.caveats: The pinned code catches history-registration failures after filesystem mutation; batch writes are sequential despite comments describing coherent/atomic tracking. Native undo must not silently promise recovery after omitted records, failed persistence, ignored content or cap truncation.
